NODES USED IN THIS WORKFLOW

No models to download. Everything here is plain picture work, so it runs on any computer and it is fast, even without a strong graphics card.

 Nodes Installed from Manager

Which version is the newest? The Latest Pixaroma version button shows it and what is new in it. The help page has the update steps for every kind of install.

Latest Pixaroma version How to update Pixaroma 

 Something missing?

Each button opens a short video that shows the fix, with the steps written under it.

HOW TO USE

Makes a smaller copy of every picture in a folder in one Run: handy for the web, for e-mail, or before you feed a folder to a model.

 Pick your folder

  1. On Load Images from Folder Pixaroma, click Browse and pick your folder, or paste the folder's path into the box.
  2. Click Pick images, then Select all, or click only the pictures you want. The button shows how many are picked.
  3. Press Run once. Leave the Run count at 1: the node sends every picture through by itself, one after the other.

This workflow opens with no folder picked: choose your own folder, or try it first on the demo folder Portraits inside the Media Inputs folder that comes with these workflows.

 A folder inside ComfyUI's own input or output folder works straight away. A folder anywhere else works too, but pick it once with Browse: that is how ComfyUI knows you allowed it.

 Pictures go through in name order. Name them 01_, 02_ and so on if the order matters.

 Set the size and the format

  • On Longest Side Pixaroma, click the size you want. The gear holds the list of sizes, so you can put your own numbers there.
  • On Save Image Pixaroma, pick PNG, JPG or WebP. The JPG and WebP quality is in its gear.
  • The results land in ComfyUI/output/Resized. Change Resized/%input% in the file name box to use another folder name, or type a full path in the folder box to save anywhere.

 How long it takes

Almost nothing: 4 pictures took 0.3 s on a 4090. There is no AI model in this workflow, so a folder of hundreds of pictures is fine.

 Something not working?

Each button opens the answer on the Pixaroma help page.

Folder not approved Save to your own folder Nodes look different from the video

WHAT EACH NODE DOES

The colour of a node tells you what kind of node it is. Nothing here needs changing except the blue ones.

 The steps you set

Blue, and numbered. These are the only nodes you need to touch.

  • Load Images from Folder Pixaroma (1. your folder) - Point it at a folder and pick the pictures. Press Run once and it sends every picture through the workflow, one after the other. Its filename output carries each picture's name to the save node, and index says which picture it is (1, 2, 3 ...).
  • Longest Side Pixaroma (2. new size) - Makes the longest side of every picture the size you click, here 768. The other side follows, so a tall picture stays tall and nothing is stretched. keep leaves each picture's own shape; the shape chips crop to a square, 16:9 and so on. Small pictures are not made bigger (Allow upscale is off in the gear).

 The result

Dark red, at the end.

  • Save Image Pixaroma (3. where and how to save) - Saves the new copies as JPG into ComfyUI/output/Resized, each with its original name (%input% is the wired file name). Your original pictures are never touched.

 Readouts

Dark. Nothing to set: they show you what happened.

  • Show Text Pixaroma (the names it read) - Shows the names of the pictures it read, one per line, after a Run. It is there so you can see the folder going through.
  • Run Timer - The dark clock above the result shows how long the last Run took.
